mapper.select: SELECT id, plan_id, layer_id, type, geometry::text AS geometry, style::text AS style, version, created_at, updated_at FROM measurement WHERE plan_id = #{planId} ORDER BY created_at, id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO measurement (id, plan_id, layer_id, type, geometry, style, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{planId}, #{layerId}, #{type}, CAST(#{geometry} AS jsonb), CAST(#{style} AS jsonb), #{version}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
